summary: AI writing and knowledge-base workspace where teams build custom agents, connect sources and automate everyday text workflows.

pricing.details: Premium 27 € per user/month billed monthly, or 22 € per user/month billed annually — knowledge bases, custom agents, agent skills and connectors, access to major models, workflow automations, included AI model usage, up to 10 GB file storage. Official prices exclude VAT; VAT is calculated at payment. Enterprise — flexible/custom pricing and dedicated deployment (SSO/SCIM/SAML, centralized billing, priority support; request a demo). No lasting Free plan was stated on the official pricing page. Labelled Premium.
